checks.title: Source text is a sequence of SourceCharacter
checks.basis: SourceCharacter :: "Any Unicode scalar value"; "The source text of a GraphQL document must be a sequence of {SourceCharacter}."

checks.title: White space is tab and space only
checks.basis: Whitespace :: "Horizontal Tab (U+0009)" | "Space (U+0020)"

checks.title: Line terminators are LF, CR and CR LF only
checks.basis: LineTerminator :: "New Line (U+000A)" | "Carriage Return (U+000D)" [lookahead != "New Line (U+000A)"] | "Carriage Return (U+000D)" "New Line (U+000A)"

checks.title: A comment runs to the end of its line
checks.basis: Comment :: `#` CommentChar* [lookahead != CommentChar]; CommentChar :: SourceCharacter but not LineTerminator

checks.title: Commas are insignificant
checks.basis: Comma :: ,; commas "are used to improve the legibility of source text and separate lexical tokens but are otherwise syntactically and semantically insignificant within GraphQL documents."

checks.title: Every character outside ignored tokens is part of a token
checks.basis: Token :: Punctuator | Name | IntValue | FloatValue | StringValue; "The character sequence must be described by a sequence of {Token} and {Ignored} lexical grammars."

checks.title: Ignored tokens may appear before and after every token
checks.basis: Ignored :: UnicodeBOM | Whitespace | LineTerminator | Comment | Comma; "Any amount of {Ignored} may appear before and after every lexical token."

checks.title: Punctuators, and `...` only as a whole
checks.basis: Punctuator :: one of ! $ & ( ) ... : = @ [ ] { | }

checks.title: Names
checks.basis: Name :: NameStart NameContinue* [lookahead != NameContinue]; NameStart :: Letter | `_`; NameContinue :: Letter | Digit | `_`

checks.title: Descriptions on operations, fragments and variables, not on the query shorthand
checks.basis: Description : StringValue; OperationDefinition : Description? OperationType Name? VariablesDefinition? Directives? SelectionSet | SelectionSet; FragmentDefinition : Description? fragment …; VariableDefinition : Description? Variable : …

checks.title: A document is one or more definitions of the kinds its grammar allows
checks.basis: Document : Definition+; Definition : ExecutableDefinition | TypeSystemDefinitionOrExtension; ExecutableDocument : ExecutableDefinition+; ExecutableDefinition : OperationDefinition | FragmentDefinition

checks.title: Operation definitions and the query shorthand
checks.basis: OperationDefinition : Description? OperationType Name? VariablesDefinition? Directives? SelectionSet | SelectionSet; OperationType : one of `query` `mutation` `subscription`

checks.title: Selection sets, including empty ones
checks.basis: SelectionSet : { Selection* }; Selection : Field | FragmentSpread | InlineFragment

checks.title: Fields
checks.basis: Field : Alias? Name Arguments? Directives? SelectionSet?

checks.title: Arguments
checks.basis: Arguments[Const] : ( Argument[?Const]+ ); Argument[Const] : Name : Value[?Const]

checks.title: Field aliases
checks.basis: Alias : Name :

checks.title: Fragment definitions and fragment spreads
checks.basis: FragmentSpread : ... FragmentName Directives?; FragmentDefinition : Description? fragment FragmentName TypeCondition Directives? SelectionSet; FragmentName : Name but not `on`

checks.title: Type conditions
checks.basis: TypeCondition : on NamedType

checks.title: Inline fragments
checks.basis: InlineFragment : ... TypeCondition? Directives? SelectionSet

checks.title: Input values, and no variables in constant values
checks.basis: Value[Const] : [~Const] Variable | IntValue | FloatValue | StringValue | BooleanValue | NullValue | EnumValue | ListValue[?Const] | ObjectValue[?Const]

checks.title: Int values
checks.basis: IntValue :: IntegerPart [lookahead != {Digit, `.`, NameStart}]; IntegerPart :: NegativeSign? 0 | NegativeSign? NonZeroDigit Digit*; "It must not have any leading {0}."

checks.title: Float values
checks.basis: FloatValue :: IntegerPart FractionalPart ExponentPart | IntegerPart FractionalPart | IntegerPart ExponentPart, each [lookahead != {Digit, `.`, NameStart}]

checks.title: Boolean values
checks.basis: BooleanValue : one of `true` `false`

checks.title: String values and block strings
checks.basis: StringValue :: `""` [lookahead != `"`] | `"` StringCharacter+ `"` | BlockString; "The hexadecimal number encoded by a Unicode escape sequence must describe a _Unicode scalar value_, otherwise must result in a parse error."

checks.title: Null value
checks.basis: NullValue : `null`

checks.title: Enum values
checks.basis: EnumValue : Name but not `true`, `false` or `null`

checks.title: List values
checks.basis: ListValue[Const] : [ ] | [ Value[?Const]+ ]

checks.title: Input object values
checks.basis: ObjectValue[Const] : { } | { ObjectField[?Const]+ }; ObjectField[Const] : Name : Value[?Const]

checks.title: Variables and variable definitions
checks.basis: Variable : $ Name; VariablesDefinition : ( VariableDefinition+ ); VariableDefinition : Description? Variable : Type DefaultValue? Directives[Const]?; DefaultValue : = Value[Const]

checks.title: Type references
checks.basis: Type : NamedType | ListType | NonNullType; NamedType : Name; ListType : [ Type ]; NonNullType : NamedType ! | ListType !

checks.title: Directives
checks.basis: Directives[Const] : Directive[?Const]+; Directive[Const] : @ Name Arguments[?Const]?

checks.title: Type system documents hold type system definitions, and extension documents extensions too
checks.basis: TypeSystemDocument : TypeSystemDefinition+ (§3); TypeSystemExtensionDocument : TypeSystemDefinitionOrExtension+; TypeSystemDefinitionOrExtension : TypeSystemDefinition | TypeSystemExtension (§3.1)

checks.title: Descriptions on type system definitions and their parts, not on extensions
checks.basis: Description : StringValue, where a production allows one: every type system definition, FieldDefinition, InputValueDefinition and EnumValueDefinition starts with Description?, and no extension does

checks.title: Schema definitions
checks.basis: SchemaDefinition : Description? schema Directives[Const]? { RootOperationTypeDefinition+ }; RootOperationTypeDefinition : OperationType : NamedType

checks.title: Schema extensions add directives or root operation types
checks.basis: SchemaExtension : extend schema Directives[Const]? { RootOperationTypeDefinition+ } | extend schema Directives[Const] [lookahead != `{`]

checks.title: A type extension names a kind of type
checks.basis: TypeExtension : ScalarTypeExtension | ObjectTypeExtension | InterfaceTypeExtension | UnionTypeExtension | EnumTypeExtension | InputObjectTypeExtension

checks.title: Scalar definitions
checks.basis: ScalarTypeDefinition : Description? scalar Name Directives[Const]?

checks.title: Scalar extensions add directives
checks.basis: ScalarTypeExtension : extend scalar Name Directives[Const]

checks.title: Object definitions, implemented interfaces and field definitions
checks.basis: ObjectTypeDefinition : Description? type Name ImplementsInterfaces? Directives[Const]? FieldsDefinition | Description? type Name ImplementsInterfaces? Directives[Const]? [lookahead != `{`]; ImplementsInterfaces : ImplementsInterfaces & NamedType | implements `&`? NamedType; FieldsDefinition : { FieldDefinition+ }; FieldDefinition : Description? Name ArgumentsDefinition? : Type Directives[Const]?

checks.title: Argument definitions
checks.basis: ArgumentsDefinition : ( InputValueDefinition+ ); InputValueDefinition : Description? Name : Type DefaultValue? Directives[Const]?

checks.title: Object extensions add interfaces, directives or fields
checks.basis: ObjectTypeExtension : extend type Name ImplementsInterfaces? Directives[Const]? FieldsDefinition | extend type Name ImplementsInterfaces? Directives[Const] [lookahead != `{`] | extend type Name ImplementsInterfaces [lookahead != `{`]

checks.title: Interface definitions
checks.basis: InterfaceTypeDefinition : Description? interface Name ImplementsInterfaces? Directives[Const]? FieldsDefinition | Description? interface Name ImplementsInterfaces? Directives[Const]? [lookahead != `{`]

checks.title: Interface extensions add interfaces, directives or fields
checks.basis: InterfaceTypeExtension : extend interface Name ImplementsInterfaces? Directives[Const]? FieldsDefinition | extend interface Name ImplementsInterfaces? Directives[Const] [lookahead != `{`] | extend interface Name ImplementsInterfaces [lookahead != `{`]

checks.title: Union definitions and their member types
checks.basis: UnionTypeDefinition : Description? union Name Directives[Const]? UnionMemberTypes?; UnionMemberTypes : UnionMemberTypes | NamedType | = `|`? NamedType

checks.title: Union extensions add directives or member types
checks.basis: UnionTypeExtension : extend union Name Directives[Const]? UnionMemberTypes | extend union Name Directives[Const]

checks.title: Enum definitions and their values
checks.basis: EnumTypeDefinition : Description? enum Name Directives[Const]? EnumValuesDefinition | Description? enum Name Directives[Const]? [lookahead != `{`]; EnumValuesDefinition : { EnumValueDefinition+ }; EnumValueDefinition : Description? EnumValue Directives[Const]?

checks.title: Enum extensions add directives or values
checks.basis: EnumTypeExtension : extend enum Name Directives[Const]? EnumValuesDefinition | extend enum Name Directives[Const] [lookahead != `{`]

checks.title: Input object definitions and their fields
checks.basis: InputObjectTypeDefinition : Description? input Name Directives[Const]? InputFieldsDefinition | Description? input Name Directives[Const]? [lookahead != `{`]; InputFieldsDefinition : { InputValueDefinition+ }

checks.title: Input object extensions add directives or fields
checks.basis: InputObjectTypeExtension : extend input Name Directives[Const]? InputFieldsDefinition | extend input Name Directives[Const] [lookahead != `{`]

checks.title: Directive definitions and their locations
checks.basis: DirectiveDefinition : Description? directive @ Name ArgumentsDefinition? Directives[Const]? `repeatable`? on DirectiveLocations; DirectiveLocations : DirectiveLocations | DirectiveLocation | `|`? DirectiveLocation; DirectiveLocation : ExecutableDirectiveLocation | TypeSystemDirectiveLocation, each one of a list of names

checks.title: Directive extensions add directives
checks.basis: DirectiveExtension : extend directive @ Name Directives[Const]
